title: Nearby Players List [HUD]
description: A functional HUD showing nearby players.
body:
![IMAGE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ed36c26c32ce59db5fab81220ccbd6d55c1391b.jpeg)
# **Nearby Players Radar (HUD)**

A lightweight and highly customizable radar for Minecraft that displays nearby players in a clean, non-intrusive HUD. Perfect for PvP, Anarchy, or just keeping track of friends.

## **Key Features:**

  • Player List: See exactly who is around you.

  • Distance Tracker: Real-time distance to each player in meters.

  • Head Previews: Displays player skins for quick identification.

  • Fully Configurable: Change the scale, position, and display order directly in-game.

![IMAGE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c5335c405aefeab682c4f5bef56b321a512de070_0.webp)
### **Controls & Settings:**

   • Open Settings: Press 'Y' to open the configuration menu (drag and resize the HUD).

   • Toggle HUD: Press 'I' to instantly enable or disable the mod.

   • Custom Bindings: You can easily change these keys in the standard Minecraft Controls menu.
